env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default budget builds the 9-key table map.
cd m
logos build ./...
cd ..

# A seed cap of 1 exhausts the search and fails with the rule ID.
cd m
! logos build -gcflags=all=-d=logosconstmapseeds=1 ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[comptime::constmap_seed_not_found\]'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmbudget

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

const nine = map[int]string{1: "a", 2: "b", 3: "c", 4: "d", 5: "e", 6: "f", 7: "g", 8: "h", 9: "i"}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(nine[5] ?? "none", nine[10] ?? "none")
}
